afd.snippet: 000 FXUS65 KGJT 281147 AFDGJT Area Forecast Discussion National Weather Service Grand Junction CO 547 AM MDT Tue Jul 28 2026 .KEY MESSAGES... - More convection today with afternoon and evening showers being the rule. - Main concern will be flash flooding, especially over burn scars, as slow moving showers and storms bring heavy rain to the area. - Dry conditions may start moving in towards the end

fwf.snippet: .DISCUSSION... Showers and thunderstorms are expected primarily over the high terrain at least through Thursday before rain potential decreases into the weekend. Thunderstorms have been producing strong outflow winds, so this will continue to be a threat through the mid-week. Slow-moving storms will also be capable of producing localized heavy rain which will threaten flash flooding and debris flo
